name: vacu-valoda
description: Vācu Valoda • LV-DE — vācu valodas mācību lietotne latviešu valodā runājošiem (Capacitor: iOS, Android, PWA).

scripts.assets:generate: npm run assets:prepare && npx capacitor-assets generate --pwaManifestPath manifest.json --splashBackgroundColor "#0f172a" --iconBackgroundColor "#0f172a" && npm run assets:normalize
scripts.cap:sync: npm run sync:www && npx cap sync
scripts.cap:copy: npm run sync:www && npx cap copy
